_comment: MDL statements that must never be executed by an agent, regardless of ownership. The guard scans the exec script (or inline -c argument) with case-insensitive matching. Patterns are plain substrings normalised to upper case; whitespace is collapsed to single spaces before matching. Add new entries sparingly and always with a reason + source. Phase 1 seed is minimal.

stop_operations.reason: Changing project-level settings via an agent is out of scope for phase 1. Settings changes require a human reviewer and a Studio Pro commit.
Project security level is a sensitive change with wide blast radius (role model, access rules). Never let an agent mutate this.
Dropping an attribute from an entity risks silent data loss; combined with secured attributes this bypasses audit. Agents must not DROP ATTRIBUTE; use a scripted migration under human review instead.
